name: block_sweep
description: SHAPE picks the matrix class: the empty entry keeps the square draw of SIZE_M and SIZE_N, the other entries draw a wide or a tall matrix. Each class holds at most 256 Ki elements, the transfer cap of the generator. SNAP rounds N down to the row alignment of the profile (a no-op with misaligned accesses). M and N: max 65535 (16-bit matrix_dim and stride/len regs).
